data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'af-r-z', meaning 'to purify' or 'to exalt'. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes spiritual cleansing and exalted status. The name Afroza carries the meaning “Pure, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Afroza usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
